clips.title: 凯茜·伍德：就业火爆市场暴跌？新美联储主席是关键
title_lines: 新美联储主席或是关键

subtitles.en: On this episode of In the Know, we certainly discuss this employment report, which was a boomer and the confusion that it's causing and give you some bearings, at least through our eyes,
subtitles.zh: 本期《In the Know》中，我们讨论了这份强劲的就业报告及其引发的困惑，并分享我们的看法，至少从我们的视角解读市场动态。

subtitles.en: as to what's going on out there in the markets. Greetings everyone. It is Employment Friday
subtitles.zh: 大家好，今天是就业星期五，

subtitles.en: and what an Employment Friday this is. Beautiful Employment Report. This economy is moving into
subtitles.zh: 而且这个就业星期五非同寻常。就业报告非常亮眼，经济正进入繁荣区间。

subtitles.en: boom territory. We've been talking about this for a while, but the markets are plummeting. What the heck is going on? Well, we think we have the answer. I think it has to do with Kevin Worsh, our new
subtitles.zh: 我们之前一直在讨论这一点，但市场却在暴跌。到底怎么回事？我们认为找到了答案，可能与我们的新任美联储主席Kevin Worsh有关。

subtitles.en: Fed chairman, who is not saying anything, at least not yet. And maybe he won't until June 17th, which is when the Fed announces its next interest rate decision. So we've got roughly 12
subtitles.zh: 他目前没有表态，至少现在没有。也许要等到6月17日美联储宣布下一次利率决定。所以我们大约有12天时间。

subtitles.en: days. I do hope he says something in the meantime, he may not, but if I understand who he is,
subtitles.zh: 我希望他在此期间能说些什么，他可能不会。但据我对他的了解，

subtitles.en: he has much more of a supply side policy bent, and he does not believe that strong employment and
subtitles.zh: 他更倾向于供给侧政策，不认为强劲的就业和增长是坏消息。

subtitles.en: strong growth is bad news. In fact, people who do believe that adhere to something called the
subtitles.zh: 事实上，持相反观点的人信奉所谓的菲利普斯曲线。

subtitles.en: Philip's Curve. When growth grows up, they think inflation goes up as well. And that's just not
subtitles.zh: 当增长加速时，他们认为通胀也会上升。但这并不正确。

subtitles.en: true. In fact, the most vibrant growth periods have been associated with much lower than expected
subtitles.zh: 实际上，最强劲的增长时期往往伴随着远低于预期的通胀。

subtitles.en: inflation. Why? Because of productivity. And I think the same thing is going to prove true now.
subtitles.zh: 通胀。为什么？因为生产率。我认为现在同样的情况将被证明是正确的。
